- Allocating cash receipts and reconciling customer accounts accurately and promptly.
- Carrying out credit checks on new and existing customers and recommending appropriate credit limits.
- Placing accounts on stop where required and communicating clearly with account managers.
- Preparing weekly cash forecasts and aged debt reports for the Finance Manager.

Our client is keen to meet people who are calm under pressure, persuasive on the phone and meticulous with detail.
